messages:
devon: Quick thread — proposing a "shadow fallback" phase before full auto-fallback. Idea: route a tiny fraction to fallback and monitor quality/latency before flipping.

nina: Product likes that. Less customer-visible churn. We should surface a clear "promote" button if shadow shows regression.

sam: Runtime OK to add a shadow mode. We'll add telemetry labels: `fallback_phase=shadow|active`, `shadow_rate`, `shadow_success_rate`. Emit single-line audit for each promotion decision.

charlie: SRE asks for safety rules: require shadow to run for at least 2 windows AND show >95% success_rate vs baseline before auto-promote. Also cooldown 60s after promotion.

zara: UX: show a small timeline tag: "shadow(0.1%) -> promote?" Drawer shows sampled responses side-by-side baseline vs fallback and a computed delta. Include "auto-promote" checkbox with strict defaults.

devon: Audit retention: keep full side-by-side samples for 21 days, promotion snapshots for 365d. Operators must be able to export the shadow batch for forensic replay.

sam: We'll add fields to the audit record: `phase`, `shadow_rate`, `baseline_metric`, `fallback_metric`, `policy_snapshot`. Example line: {"phase":"shadow","shadow_rate":0.001,"baseline_p95":120,"fallback_p95":80,"policy_version":"v12"} emitted to logs.

nina: Product: operator-initiated promotes must be immutable with who/timestamp and the exact policy snapshot. Replay token required.

charlie: Edge case: for quota-driven fallbacks, shadow shouldn't count towards quota limits. Make shadow traffic tagged and exempt from billing/quota.

zara: UI nit: show sample coverage and confidence intervals for the delta so operators know if samples are statistically significant.

devon: Action items: @sam implement `fallback_phase` tag + shadow sampling and audit fields; @charlie finalize promotion heuristics and quota-exemption; @zara mock the side-by-side drawer and promote modal; @nina spec operator audit format and replay token. I'll schedule a 20m sync tomorrow.

opsbot: ci/rollouts/shadow  canary ok on 1 route.

sam: quick note — default shadow_rate 0.1% but tenant-adjustable.

charlie: SGTM. Also add an operator-expiring hold when someone pauses auto-promote.

devon: Sweet. Thanks all :rocket:
